name: Honda CB360
engine: 356 cc air-cooled SOHC parallel twin, two carbs, six-speed
intro: The CB350's replacement. A six-speed twin that's easy to live with once the top end and carbs are right.

add.title: Check the rocker shafts and cam
add.instructions: With the valve cover off, check that the rocker shafts can't turn in the cover and look for wear in their sockets and on the cam lobes. Later shafts screw in to stop this.
add.reason: Early CB360s used loose rocker shafts that could rotate and wear the cover.

H: A clutch cable outer that's a few mm too long makes the clutch fussy to adjust. Check it before you blame the clutch.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Loose rocker shafts
known.what: Early shafts could rotate and wear the head cover.

known.title: Long clutch cables
known.what: Many replacement cables are about 4 mm too long.
